stem: What comes next in the series: 4, 9, 14, 19, 24, ?

per_option_rationale.rationale: Adds 3 instead of 5 to 24, giving 27. A slip in the common difference.
Adds 4 instead of 5 to 24, giving 28. A slip in identifying the common difference.
This is an AP with first term 4 and common difference 5. Each term adds 5: 4, 9, 14, 19, 24, 29.
Adds 6 to 24 = 30, wrongly believing the differences increase by 1 each step (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, ...) from some assumed base.

explanation: The series is an arithmetic progression with first term 4 and common difference 5. Adding 5 to each term: 4 + 5 = 9, 9 + 5 = 14, 14 + 5 = 19, 19 + 5 = 24, 24 + 5 = 29.

explanation_sections.punchline: A constant difference of 5 runs through every consecutive pair, confirming a pure AP.
explanation_sections.approach: Apply clues most-certain-first: compute differences: 9-4=5, 14-9=5, 19-14=5, 24-19=5. Constant difference confirmed. Next term = 24 + 5 = 29.
explanation_sections.lesson: Always compute all consecutive differences before deciding the pattern; one consistent value means AP.
explanation_sections.timing: 15-20 seconds. No elimination needed once the constant difference is spotted.
